messages:
jordan: quick heads-up   noticed inconsistent env var names across SDKs (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs RW_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY). causing confusion in sampleapp + k8s deploys.
lee: yep, users export REDWOOD_API_KEY but `rw login` still prompts. onboarding friction.
samir: proposal: canonicalize to REDWOOD_API_KEY, accept RW_API_KEY for legacy, and document precedence (REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY > RW_API_KEY).
maya: rotation story: long-running processes don't reload env. add CredProvider interface with refresh callbacks and provide secret-manager example (Vault/SM) in sampleapp.
olivia: also make SDKs treat empty-string env as unset and log any fallback events. add tests for empty-env handling.
devops-bot: note: k8s env names are case-sensitive; recommend UPPER_SNAKE and mounting via env or volume as appropriate.
security: do not silently substitute a lower-privilege token for a required higher-privilege one. fallback must be explicit in logs and audit trails.
devex: action items: sampleapp secret-manager example (lee), SDK tests + empty-env fix (olivia), cred-lint rule to catch env mismatches (samir), CLI doc for `rw creds refresh` and SIGHUP pattern (jordan), security review (security).
